## Learning objectives

- Recognize field heterogeneity and its effect on genotype ranking
- Diagnose spatial patterns in residuals
- Fit a spatial model with SpATS and interpret its outputs
- Quantify the gain of spatial correction

## Spatial models with 2D P-splines

<!-- TODO: SpATS: spatial trend, row/column effects, BLUPs/BLUEs. -->

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(SpATS)
m_sp <- SpATS(response = "yield", genotype = "geno", genotype.as.random = TRUE,
              spatial = ~ PSANOVA(col, row, nseg = c(10, 10)),
              fixed = ~ rep, random = ~ rowf + colf, data = trial)
plot(m_sp)
getHeritability(m_sp)
```
